topic: Creating DNS aliases for environment selection
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the technical requirement to create two specific DNS aliases: `ml-api.allunite.local` pointing to `ml-api-prod.allunite.local`, and `staging-ml-api.allunite.local` pointing to `ml-api-stage.allunite.local`. This setup is intended to allow the code to dynamically select the environment (prod/stage) using a simple substitution variable, as demonstrated in the provided SQL query structure.
decisions: DNS aliases will be created for production and staging environments.
action_items: p1 will create the required DNS aliases tomorrow.
